# biomes/rheolith: index

*Generated by `tools/make_index.py`. Do not edit; rerun it after adding or splitting fragments.*

The Rheoliths (PLAN.md): a non-terran mineral-siloxane biosphere (Four-Day panspermia) confined to 180-550 degC dry-acid volcanic throats, leaving eight dead or dormant surface byproducts, fugitive cyclic siloxane and organoselenium vapours that set Ranj fruiting, and reagent choke control ([Gag / Salt / Dross / Reset]). Station 1, the Breached Throat (stations/throat, dist/rheolith.html): a collapsed fumarole skylight in a SE Throne rift graben (1,380 m, 1.18 atm), live chokecoral, wirevein, foamreef and fluxcreeper inside the glowing throat, bismuth hoppers (KGEODE), wild vs sterile Ranj (throne kin read in place). Verified: build.py, tests/test-rheolith.js, verify.py --assert. Read BIOME-API.md

Docs: `BIOME-API.md`, `KNOWN_ISSUES.md`, `NOTES.md`, `PLAN.md`, `PORT.md`

Built output (never open it; edit `src/` and rebuild): `dist/rheolith.html`

Build: `cd biomes/rheolith && python3 build.py`. Fragments are concatenated in filename order.
Fragments marked **big** are over 30 KB: find the section below and read only that range.

From `core/terrain/` (shared; see `core/README.md`): `35-core-strata.js`, `39-core-cavern.js`, `39f-core-geode.js`, `43-core-ground.js`, `44-core-farfield.js`, `45-core-horizon.js`, `47-core-therm.js`
